blocks.text: Queen Mary Park homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Queen Mary Park, September 2026. Detached houses: 71 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 3% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 89 listed at month end and 8 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 13 sold over 4 months against an average of 66.5 listed, about 20.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 4 sold. Condos and townhomes: 37 sold over 4 months against an average of 82.2 listed, about 8.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 14 sold.

faq.q: Which schools serve Queen Mary Park?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD36 and no catchment for a Queen Mary Park address is stated as fact in this file. Schools confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file in or beside the sub-area include David Brankin, Senator Reid, Betty Huff, Kennedy Trail and Kirkbride elementaries and Queen Elizabeth and L.A. Matheson secondaries — run the exact address in the SD36 School Locator before relying on any of them (BC Ministry K-12 schools file, 2025/2026, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Are basement suites allowed in Queen Mary Park houses?
faq.a: Surrey permits one secondary suite per single-family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, at most 40% of the principal unit's habitable floor area, and never inside a coach house or garden suite; a specific home's suite legality must be confirmed with the City — listings in this sub-area include homes described with unauthorized suites.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Queen Mary Park Surrey?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 71 houses listed with 2 sold in the month and 89 condos and townhomes listed with 8 sold in the month in Queen Mary Park Surrey. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Queen Mary Park Surrey a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 3%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 9%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
